content: Consul KV (developer.hashicorp.com): blocking queries (long-poll via index/wait params) on most read endpoints; watches built on blocking queries; /txn endpoint for atomic multi-key KV transactions (max 64 ops); per-request consistency modes: default (leader-verified), consistent (quorum), stale (any server, may lag); ACL policies (key:read/key:write) on every endpoint; operator snapshot API for backup/restore; known hard limit ~9-10k on blocking API (GH issue #8995).
